title: Build production agents with computer use, the Skills API, and the Files API
translatedTitle: 使用 Computer use、Skills API 和 Files API 构建生产级智能体
subtitle: Computer use, the Skills API, and the Files API are generally available on the Claude Platform today. Computer use also adds a new browser use tool for agents that work in web applications. Together they let you build agents that operate software, apply your team's expertise, and return finished files.
